verdict.summary_en: Chinese-language delivery note SN-261001-151 dated 2026-10-01 from Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd. to Soony DC Hamburg, against PO 4500318716. It covers 122 PCS of CMP-GAM-003 Game Card Case (clear) in 122 packages, gross weight 1586 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. It carries a DC-HAM receiving stamp dated 05.11.2026 and a handwritten receiver signature 'Meyer K.'. The note has no corrections or strike-throughs, and no discrepancy is stated.
observations: Red circular supplier seal (出货专用章, 'shipping dedicated seal') overlaps the table header cells for unit and packages and the packages value '122'. The values are still readable.
Quantity printed as '122.000'. In the Chinese document's convention this is 122 pieces, which matches the 122 packages count.
Blue rectangular stamp 'RECEIVED 05.11.2026 DC-HAM' is the receiving date stamp.
Handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' above the receiver signature line (收货签字). It is a signature, not a correction.
No handwritten quantity changes or crossed-out values. No inspection result or acceptance/rejection is stated.
